description:
Independent measurements for ONE tool, by catalog id or public MCP URL: verdict, success rate, consecutive successes, latency, last 20 checks. Unknown tools are queued and measured within ~10-20 minutes. 'Not measured' never means 'bad'.
Use when: you already know which tool and want to know if it works now.
Do not use when: you are still looking for a tool (use solve_need).
Example: {"url":"https://example.com/mcp"}

id.description: Catalog id of the server, e.g. io.github.owner/server (use this or url)

name: check_reliability
title: Audit one known tool
